thesis: The podcast argues that the current AI landscape differs from the internet era because there is no supply overhang of compute, meaning every dollar invested in models translates directly to immediate demand and capability. It further suggests that model companies can raise enough capital to out-pay application builders, creating uncertainty over whether value will accrue to the model layer or fragment toward companies closest to the end user.
